cards.meaning: to cry out in complaint; to wince or protest at a cost
cards.example: Umaray ang mga mamimili sa presyo ng gasolina at bigas.
cards.exampleMeaning: Consumers cried out over the price of fuel and rice.
cards.note: Pang-araw-araw at medyo matalinghaga; mas malakas ang dating kaysa sa 'nagreklamo'. Kadalasang sinusundan ng 'sa' + sanhi ng sakit o gastos.
cards.tiesTo: Peso at P64 and oil-driven inflation hitting households

cards.meaning: response; the act of addressing a problem
cards.example: Kailangan ng mabilis na pagtugon ng pamahalaan sa paghina ng piso.
cards.exampleMeaning: The government needs a swift response to the peso's weakness.
cards.note: Pormal; ginagamit sa balita at pahayag ng gobyerno. Kaiba sa 'sagot' na tumutukoy sa tanong; ang 'pagtugon' ay aksyon sa isang problema.
cards.tiesTo: Gatchalian's reenacted-budget warning and Marcos's peso pledge

cards.meaning: to appreciate (of a currency or asset)
cards.example: 人民币升值了，出口企业的压力就更大。
cards.examplePinyin: Rénmínbì shēngzhí le, chūkǒu qǐyè de yālì jiù gèng dà.
cards.exampleMeaning: When the renminbi appreciates, the pressure on exporters grows.
cards.note: Neutral-to-formal, used for currencies and assets; opposite is 贬值. Contrast 上涨 (a price simply rising); 升值 implies value gained against something else. Collocates with 人民币, 房产.

cards.meaning: to have a shock impact on
cards.example: 美元走强对新兴市场造成冲击。
cards.examplePinyin: Měiyuán zǒuqiáng duì xīnxīng shìchǎng zàochéng chōngjī.
cards.exampleMeaning: A stronger dollar has a shock impact on emerging markets.
cards.note: Abstract collocation, 书面语 (written/formal). Contrast 影响 (neutral 'affect'); 冲击 stresses a sudden, disruptive blow. Often with 市场, 经济, 出口.
cards.tiesTo: Dollar and oil shocks hitting Asian markets, the KOSPI crash
